notes.title: Living with my Little Sister is now available to purchase!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021791/1c1f45fa604f409e84e6c19b7c378121429597ba.png

We’re overjoyed to announce the official release of Living with my Little Sister, developed by Ero Flash Club! The game is available right now, with a special 20% off launch discount! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3478020/Living_with_my_Little_Sister/

Trailer:
[previewyoutube=7bTU20IhoAg;full][/previewyoutube]

Your truant younger sister decided to crash at your place. Improve your relationship by spending time with her while balancing your job as an illustrator. Give her a head pat, cook for her, have a chat, and maybe, over time, she'll open up to you.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021791/65d4300208f6a2a630307634ced35b74ec126a93.png
Hello, everyone!

We’re delighted to reveal our next upcoming release Hell's 8 Avenue: Miori's Mysterious Notebook!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3641720/Hells_8_Avenue_Mioris_Mysterious_Notebook/

In this adventure game, play as Miori, a young detective tasked with finding a missing person and purifying the ominous 'Illusory 8th Street.' Challenge your dexterity with fun Quick Time Events and push forward... or get punished for being too slow.
